subject: spanish
topicDisplay: Context 2: Local National International & Global Areas Of Interest

rounds.lie: “El vuelo lleva retraso” means “the flight is on time”.
rounds.why: “Llevar retraso” means “to be delayed/late”, so the flight is delayed, not on time (“a tiempo”).
rounds.truth: “El vuelo lleva retraso” means “the flight is delayed”.

rounds.lie: “El medio ambiente” means “the middle of the room”.
rounds.why: “El medio ambiente” is a set phrase meaning “the environment”, not anything to do with a room.
It is a classic false friend: “la librería” means “bookshop”; “the library” is “la biblioteca”.

rounds.lie: “Las especies están en peligro de extinción” means “the spices are in danger”.
rounds.why: “Las especies” means “species” (animals/plants); “spices” is the near-miss word “las especias”.
rounds.truth: “Las especies están en peligro de extinción” means “the species are in danger of extinction”.

rounds.why: “La aduana” means “customs”, where bags are checked at a border; “the ticket office” is “la taquilla”.

truths: “La estación de tren” means “the train station”.
“Hacer las maletas” means “to pack the suitcases”.

rounds.lie: “Vivo aquí desde hace diez años” means “I lived here ten years ago”.
rounds.why: “Desde hace” with the present tense means an action still going on, so it means “I have lived here for ten years”.
rounds.truth: “Vivo aquí desde hace diez años” means “I have lived here for ten years”.
